propositions: init.py at 786 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap with only 14 lines of headroom and must be reduced to at most 650 LOC

init.py contains two unrelated subsystems with no calls between them: host-repo tracker provisioning (init_cli/init_core) and tickets-branch convergence units (ensure units) that are only called by _store/ensures._registry()

The five ensure units (_gc_config_unit, _merge_ours_unit, _gitignore_unit, _gitattributes_unit, _store_compat_unit) and their two content templates (_GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES) must move to a new _init_ensures.py module while staying accessible to _store/ensures._registry() via re-export

_untrack_runtime_markers_unit and _UNTRACK_BATCH must remain in init.py because _untrack_runtime_markers_unit is not a content converger and test_ensures_untrack_markers.py:155 patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute

All monkeypatches in the test suite target symbols that remain in init.py after the split, and path-keyed registries (.github/complexity-baseline.json, check_raw_git_writes.py, module-size-limit.txt) are unaffected by the move
